To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the terminal stages of cortisol production in the human and rat adrenal glands are catalysed, respectively, by the enzymes 17beta-hydroxysteroid dehydrogenase type 2 (HSD17B2) and 11beta-hydorxylase.
the final stages of cortisol and mineralocorticoid biosynthesis are catalysed in the human adrenal cortex by the enzymes CYP11B and CYP11b2 respectively.

the terminal stages of cortisol (11beta-hydroxylation) and aldosterone (11beta-hydoxylation and 18-hydroxylation of deoxycorticosterone) synthesis are catalysed in the rat brain by the enzymes 111beta-hydrox ylase and aldosterone-synthase, which are coded by the CYP1 1B1 and C YP 1 1B2 genes, respectively.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the adrenal and non-adrenal tissues in the regulation of the renin-angiotensin-aldosterone system (RAAS) in hypertension.
the expression of the 11 beta hydroxylase and the aldosterone synthase gene in the rat brain and the localisation of the enzymes in the brain.
the synthesis of steroids in non-adrenal tissues and the possible physiological role of these steroids in the brain, heart, vascular and immune systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
CYP11B genes are present in rat brain, and the proteins encoded by them are expressed in the brain.
CYP11B enzymes are found in the adrenal cortex and brain, and that the enzymes may be involved in localised corticosteroidogenesis in the brain.
the expression of 11beta-HSD and aldosterone synthases in the brain are not restricted to the cerebellum and hippocampus, but are also present in the hypothalamus.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
11beta-hyroxyalse and aldosterone synthases are present in rat brain and that the expression is highest in the cerebellar Purkinje cells and the hippocampal neurons.
aldosterone and 11-Deoxycorticosterone are made in the rat brain and may have a role in central nervous system regulation of blood pressure.
the CYP11b1 enzyme is present in the brain and is expressed in Purkinje cells of the cerebellum and in the hippocampus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
aldosterone and its precursor deoxycorticosterone may be made in the brain and may be involved in the regulation of the cardiovascular system.
aldosterone synthase and 11beta-hydrolase are expressed in specific brain areas.
aldosterone and cortisone are produced in the rat brain, and that this production may be important in the control of blood pressure and other functions of the cardiovascular system.
